> ⚠ `inflight-board.md` IS ONE LANE ONLY. Its single writer (`gpu-ternary-fep-vast.yml`
> `task=collect`) rewrites it wholesale from the ternary lane's rows, so it can never carry another
> lane. **This** file is the all-lane board. Each lane writes only its own fragment
> (`inflight-board.d/<lane>.json`, or the file above for the ternary lane) and nothing else, so no
> two writers share a path and no lane can erase another's rows.

> A lane whose fragment is older than 15 min renders STALE rather than vanishing — the line is
> `vast_idle_guard.LOG_SILENCE_MIN`, imported, because a lane's fragment is its heartbeat.
